answer: The yarrow here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Authorised seamstress registry writ is the proof, because a writ seamstresses file after stitch trials. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The lagoon is small, but the toll is 11 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One anchor, one entry.
